experiment_data.hypothesis: Death dominance mechanism (DAF ~78.9% on Qwen-7B) generalizes across model families: Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct on the same 11 ScienceWorld tasks will show (1) DAF direction consistent with Qwen, (2) similar death-prone vs non-death-prone task pattern, and (3) high per-task death rate correlation with Qwen. This validates C3's cross-model generality claim beyond the limited pilot (7 tasks, 70 eps).
